stemMd: An insurer reduced the number of claims it received but paid more in total compensation. Which explanation best reconciles these facts?

options.label: C
options.textMd: The remaining claims were sufficiently more expensive on average.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The insurer opened a new office.

explanationMd: Total compensation is the number of paid claims multiplied by their average payment. A sufficiently large increase in severity can outweigh fewer claims. The comparison concerns frequency and size, not processing speed.

distractorRationale.b: Processing speed is separate from payment amount.
distractorRationale.d: Office expansion does not establish claim payouts.
distractorRationale.e: Submission medium does not determine compensation size.
distractorRationale.a: Advertising does not explain average claim severity.
